questions.stem: In an experiment to test whether water is needed for germination, what should be kept the same in both the test and control groups?

options.text: The type of seed, temperature, and access to oxygen
The amount of light each group receives
The amount of water given to each group

questions.explanation: To make the experiment a fair test, all variables except water must be kept the same (controlled). This includes using the same type of seed, the same temperature, and the same access to oxygen.
